summary.text: Eddie Morales Jr. is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 74 who has represented the district since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Eddie Morales Jr. was born in Piedras Negras, Coahuila, Mexico, and earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1997 and a graduate degree from St. Mary's Law School in 2000.

His career experience includes working as an attorney and owning a business, and he has served as president of the Maverick County Bar Association, on the St. Mary's Law Alumni Board, and on the Texas State Bar Grievance Committee.
Morales took office on January 12, 2021, succeeding Poncho Nevarez.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Elections, Energy Resources (as vice chair), and Local & Consent Calendars.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
